name: Piperacillin + Tazobactam
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Piperacillin-tazobactam doses are reduced when creatinine clearance (CrCl) is 40 mL/min or less and in dialysis. The US label sets separate regimens for nosocomial pneumonia and adds a small extra dose after each hemodialysis session. In critical illness, prolonged or continuous infusion of the same daily dose may be used per local protocol (label regimens are 30-minute infusions).

bands.recommendation: 3.375 g every 6 hours; nosocomial pneumonia 4.5 g every 6 hours (label: CrCl >40).
CrCl >40: usual dosing. CrCl 20–40: 2.25 g every 6 hours; nosocomial pneumonia 3.375 g every 6 hours (label).
CrCl 20–40: as above. CrCl <20: 2.25 g every 8 hours; nosocomial pneumonia 2.25 g every 6 hours (label).
2.25 g every 8 hours; nosocomial pneumonia 2.25 g every 6 hours (label: CrCl <20).

hd.text: 2.25 g every 12 hours (nosocomial pneumonia 2.25 g every 8 hours) plus 0.75 g after each hemodialysis session on dialysis days (label). Hemodialysis removes 30 to 40% of a dose.

pd.text: CAPD: 2.25 g every 12 hours; nosocomial pneumonia 2.25 g every 8 hours (label). PD removes about 6% of piperacillin and 21% of tazobactam.

crrt.text: Not in label. Published CRRT regimens: 3.375 g every 6 hours (CVVHD/CVVHDF) up to 4.5 g every 6 hours; consider extended or continuous infusion (up to 18 g/day for less-susceptible organisms or septic shock); specialist input (Li 2020).

dialyzable: Yes: hemodialysis removes 30 to 40% of a dose (label).
monitoring: Kidney function; with vancomycin, watch for acute kidney injury; sodium load; neurotoxicity at high levels in kidney failure.

pediatric.approved_ages: Appendicitis/peritonitis and nosocomial pneumonia: 2 months and older (label).
pediatric.usual_dose: Up to 40 kg, normal kidney function: 2 to 9 months, 90 mg/kg (80 mg piperacillin/10 mg tazobactam) every 8 hours (peritonitis) or every 6 hours (pneumonia); over 9 months, 112.5 mg/kg (100 mg/12.5 mg) every 8 hours (peritonitis) or every 6 hours (pneumonia). Over 40 kg: adult dose (label).
pediatric.max_dose: Adult dose for children over 40 kg (label).

renal.recommendation: Dosage in pediatric patients with renal impairment has not been determined (label). Specialist input.
Dosage in pediatric patients with renal impairment has not been determined (label). Specialist input.
Dosage in pediatric patients with renal impairment has not been determined (label). Specialist input.

pediatric.neonates: Neonates (under 2 months): not established in this label; specialist input.
pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)
